title: Dance Dance Retribution
description: Dance Dance Retribution — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Townston Commander

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Head down into the Lower Off Dungeons of Balzack's Burrow and confiscate the smuggled Dance Lessons from the Oroks there. Bring the Dance Lessons back to the Townston Commander, in Townston, when complete.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Townston Commander

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Don't Save the Last Dance

Zone: Balzack's Burrow

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Head down into the Lower Off Dungeons of Balzack's Burrow and confiscate the smuggled Dance Lessons from the Oroks there. Bring the Dance Lessons back to the Townston Commander, in Townston, when complete.

Offer:

Do you like to dance? You look like the type who knows how to cut loose and do the Townston Two-Step from time to time. Not that there are any other dances you could be doing, or we would be having a different conversation entirely.

Well it looks like Abadunkadunkaddonna is up to her old tricks again, or are they new? I can't keep track of all the members of the Aba- family, but they sure love their music. Anyway, Abadunkadunkaddonna is an Interpretive Dancer, you may remember--or not. And it looks like she wants to spread her own style of dance into Balzack's Burrow dance club. She is using her smuggling connections to bring in Dance Lessons for the Oroks. We don't know if it is her dance or not, but we can't let the Oroks learn it!

I need you to head down into Balzack's Burrow and confiscate the Dance Lessons that are being smuggled in. Once you have collected as many as you can carry, bring them back up here to Townston and hand them over to me, the Townston Commander.

Turn-in:

Is this a joke? All of the pages are blank! You're pulling my....ohhhh I get it. It's *interpretive* dance, so there are no set steps. Something tells me Abadunkadunkaddonna isn't getting her money's worth.

Objectives:

  • Dance Lessons ×20

Level range: 60–100
